article.headline: Price scores 21 in Nevada's 67-60 victory over New Mexico
article.description: — Elijah Price had 21 points, 12 rebounds and four blocks in Nevada's 67-60 win over New Mexico on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Price scores 21 in Nevada's 67-60 victory over New Mexico

event.description: New Mexico Lobos @ Nevada Wolf Pack

keywords: New Mexico Lobos @ Nevada Wolf Pack
article.story: RENO, Nev. -- — Elijah Price had 21 points, 12 rebounds and four blocks in Nevada's 67-60 win over New Mexico on Tuesday night. Corey Camper Jr. scored 20 points and added eight rebounds and five assists for the Wolf Pack (19-9, 11-6 Mountain West Conference). Vaughn Weems also scored 20 points and shot 8 for 13, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc. Jake Hall led the way for the Lobos (21-7, 12-5) with 17 points and two steals. New Mexico got 13 points from Deyton Albury. Uriah Tenette also had 11 points. The game was tied 23-all at halftime. Nevada took the lead for good with 4:08 left in the second half on a free throw from Price to make it a 55-54. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
